name: nexus-sc-competitive
description: Windows-first competitive platform for Star Citizen

scripts.package:windows: pnpm run build && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/Package-Windows.ps1
scripts.release:windows: pnpm run package:windows && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/Make-PortableRelease.ps1
scripts.refresh:portable: pnpm run build && node scripts/Refresh-PortableRelease.cjs && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/Make-PortableRelease.ps1
